title: Case 1: Classic PCOM (String-of-Pearls)
notes: Follicle Number Per Ovary (FNPO = 30) with marked subcapsular crowding (PDI = 0.706) and dense central stroma.

findings_narrative: Follicle Number Per Ovary (FNPO): 30 antral follicles localized within ovarian boundary (Rotterdam threshold >= 12; revised threshold >= 20).
Peripheral Dispersion Index (PDI): Mean = 0.706, Median = 0.734 (Values > 0.65 indicate significant subcapsular displacement).
Peripheral Ring Concentration (PRC >= 0.65): 56.7% of follicles are aligned along the subcapsular rim.
Central Stromal Sparing Index: 3.3% central follicle occupancy (PCOS typically exhibits stromal clearance < 15%).
Stromal-to-Total Area Ratio: 92.2% of ovarian area composed of dense central stroma.
Average Follicle Caliber: 2.35 mm (within typical 2–9 mm antral follicle physiological band).
clinical_recommendations: Correlate with biochemical hyperandrogenism (Free Testosterone, FAI, DHEAS).
Consider serum Anti-Mullerian Hormone (AMH) measurement for confirmation.
